The team was led by fourth-year head coach [[Jerry Stackhouse]], and played their home games at [[Memorial Gymnasium (Vanderbilt University)|Memorial Gymnasium]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 18–13, 11–7 in SEC Play, in a three-way tie for 4th place. They defeated [[2022–23 LSU Tigers men's basketball team|LSU]] and [[2022–23 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] to advance to the semifinals of the [[2023 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], where they were defeated by [[2022–23 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2022–23 Yale Bulldogs men's basketball team|Yale]] and [[2022–23 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2022–23 UAB Blazers men's basketball team|UAB]]. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Commodores]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 19–16, 7–11 in [[2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC Play]] to finish in 11th place. They defeated [[2021–22 Georgia Bulldogs basketball team|Georgia]] and [[2021–22 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]] to advance to the quarterfinals of the [[2022 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] where they lost to [[2021–22 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2021–22 Belmont Bruins men's basketball team|Belmont]] and [[2021–22 Dayton Flyers men's basketball team|Dayton]] before losing to [[2021–22 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] in the quarterfinals. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
